title: Associative normalized compositors for arbitrary semilinear systems
statement:
Let $C_1\leftarrow C_2\leftarrow\cdots$ be arbitrary commutative rings, and use the ordinary and unbounded derived semilinear system operations and specified adjunctions of [def-sp-varying-ring-operations]. Here $P_f=D(f^*_{\bullet})$ denotes exact derived inverse image, $S_f=Rf_{*,\bullet}$ denotes total derived direct image, and $J_j=D(j_{!,\bullet})$ denotes open extension. For scheme maps $f:X\to Y$, $g:Y\to Z$, let $d_{g,f}:P_fP_g\cong P_{gf}$ be exact localization of the unit-preserving ordinary inverse-image compositor; let $c_{g,f}:S_gS_f\cong S_{gf}$ be its right-adjoint conjugate. For open immersions $a:U\to V$, $b:V\to X$, let $e_{b,a}:J_bJ_a\cong J_{ba}$ be the corresponding open-adjoint compositor. These three families are associative and unital under the normalized identity comparisons. Explicitly
$$d_{hg,f}\circ(P_f d_{h,g})=d_{h,gf}\circ(d_{g,f}P_h),\quad c_{h,gf}\circ(S_h c_{g,f})=c_{hg,f}\circ(c_{h,g}S_f),$$
and $e_{c,ba}\circ(J_c e_{b,a})=e_{cb,a}\circ(e_{c,b}J_a)$ for composable opens $a,b,c$, with the functor associators understood. The same equations hold after transport along any supplied equalities of scheme morphisms. They refer to these specified adjunctions and do not assert equality of different adjunction structures.

source.place: Tag 0D6D (lemma-derived-pullback-composition); agent-written section-normalized coherence for the ringed sequence sites

proof.text: Write $F_f=f^*_{\bullet}$ and $T_f=f_{*,\bullet}$ for the ordinary functors of [def-sp-varying-ring-operations], and $q_{g,f}:T_gT_f\cong T_{gf}$ for their section-normalized comparison. For three maps $f:X\to Y$, $g:Y\to Z$, $h:Z\to W$, both pastings defining $T_hT_gT_f\to T_{hgf}$ are restrictions along the same map between the iterated fibre products over a test object $H\to W$: its projections to $H$ and $X$ are the original projections. Uniqueness in [def-pc-fibre-product] makes the two maps equal. Applying each $M_n$ gives equality on every section, hence equality of system morphisms and natural transformations. For an identity map, the same projection check identifies $q$ with the appropriate whiskering of $i_X:T_{1_X}\cong\mathrm{id}$, the normalized pullback-graph comparison. Thus the $q$ satisfy associativity and both unit laws on the actual semilinear systems.

source.place: Tag 0D6D (lemma-derived-pullback-composition), ordinary composition input; section normalization of def-sp-varying-ring-operations

proof.text:
Let $u_{g,f}:F_fF_g\cong F_{gf}$ be the ordinary unit-preserving comparison. Apply [lem-trf-adjoint-composition-coherence] to $\mathscr S_W,\mathscr S_Z,\mathscr S_Y,\mathscr S_X$, with successive left adjoints $F_h,F_g,F_f$ and right adjoints $T_h,T_g,T_f$. Take its $d_{ijk}$ to be the inverses of the corresponding $q$ from step 1; its hypothesis is exactly the inverse of the sectionwise associativity just proved. The composite adjunctions are those of [def-weil-pbc-composite-adjunction]. By the uniqueness in [lem-weil-pbc-conjugate-iso-unit-equation], its $a_{ijk}$ are precisely the $u$ specified by [def-sp-varying-ring-operations]. Its conclusion is therefore
$$u_{hg,f}\circ(F_f u_{h,g})=u_{h,gf}\circ(u_{g,f}F_h).$$

source.place: Tag 0B65 (lemma-transformation-between-functors-and-adjoints); adjoint associativity as stated in lem-trf-adjoint-composition-coherence

proof.text:
Here is also the unit check, without identifying different adjunction structures. For an identity adjunction comparison $I\dashv T$, $i:T\cong\mathrm{id}$ and its normalized $a:I\cong\mathrm{id}$, [lem-weil-pbc-conjugate-iso-unit-equation] gives $T(a_M)\eta_{I,M}=i_M^{-1}$. For $F\dashv R$ the unit formula of [def-weil-pbc-composite-adjunction] shows that the proposed comparison $F(a_M):FI(M)\to F(M)$ has unit equation
$$TR(Fa_M)\,T(\eta_{F,IM})\eta_{I,M}=T(\eta_{F,M})i_M^{-1}=i_{RFM}^{-1}\eta_{F,M},$$
by naturality of $\eta_F$ and $i$. The other proposed comparison $a_{FM}:IF(M)\to F(M)$ has unit equation
$$RT(a_{FM})\,R(\eta_{I,FM})\eta_{F,M}=R(i_{FM}^{-1})\eta_{F,M}.$$
These are exactly the right-adjoint comparisons from step 1, inverted. Unit-compatible uniqueness therefore identifies them with $u_{1,f}$ and $u_{f,1}$. This proves both ordinary inverse-image unit laws for the identity normalization in [def-sp-varying-ring-operations].

source.place: Tag 0B65 (lemma-transformation-between-functors-and-adjoints) and Tag 0DV0 (lemma-compose-counits); explicit unit calculation

proof.text:
Pass to cochain complexes and then their localization. Exactness and additivity of every $F_f$ are supplied by [def-sp-varying-ring-operations]; [lem-weil-pbc-exact-functor-derived-factorization] gives its termwise realization on every complex. If $a_f:P_fQ\cong QC(F_f)$ is its factorization, set
$$A_{f,g,K}=a_{f,C(F_g)K}\circ P_f(a_{g,K}),$$
and analogously let $A_{f,g,h,K}$ be the three-factor composite. The definition of the localized compositor is
$$a_{gf,K}\,d_{g,f,QK}=Q(C(u_{g,f})_K)\,A_{f,g,K}.$$
Substitution in either three-factor pasting cancels the intermediate $a$'s, by their naturality. After postcomposition by $a_{hgf,K}$, the two answers are respectively $Q(C(u_{hg,f}\circ F_fu_{h,g})_K)A_{f,g,h,K}$ and $Q(C(u_{h,gf}\circ u_{g,f}F_h)_K)A_{f,g,h,K}$. They agree by step 2. The identical substitution for the two unit equations of step 3 gives the derived unit equations. Part (3) of [lem-weil-pbc-localization-universal-property] promotes these component equalities at $QK$ to equalities of natural transformations, giving the stated equation for $d$ and its units. This uses all complexes and imposes no boundedness hypothesis.

source.place: Tag 04VG (lemma-properties-left-localization), with fully faithful precomposition as stated in lem-weil-pbc-localization-universal-property; exact termwise construction

proof.text:
Put $t_{g,f}=d_{g,f}^{-1}:P_{gf}\to P_fP_g$. By [def-sp-varying-ring-operations] and [def-weil-pbc-adjunction-conjugate], $c_{g,f}$ is the conjugate of $t_{g,f}$ for the specified adjunctions $P_f\dashv S_f$ and their composites [def-weil-pbc-composite-adjunction]. Invert step 4's associativity equation to obtain
$$(P_f t_{h,g})\circ t_{hg,f}=(t_{g,f}P_h)\circ t_{h,gf}:P_{hgf}\to P_fP_gP_h.$$
Take conjugates under the single total adjunction and the threefold composite adjunction. Composition of conjugates [def-weil-pbc-adjunction-conjugate] and pasting along adjunctions [lem-weil-pbc-mate-pasting] (2) identify the left side's conjugate with $c_{hg,f}\circ(c_{h,g}S_f)$ and the right side's with $c_{h,gf}\circ(S_hc_{g,f})$. This is the asserted $c$ equation. Apply the same conjugation to the two inverse unit equations from step 4: pasting gives the respective whiskerings of the specified $S_{1}\cong\mathrm{id}$, and the identity mate is the identity by part (4) of the pasting node. Thus $c$ has both unit laws as well. Only conjugates between adjoint functors are used, so invertibility follows from the conjugate bijection.

source.place: Tag 0D6E (lemma-derived-pushforward-composition), uniqueness of adjoints; mate pasting in lem-weil-pbc-mate-pasting (2),(4)

proof.text:
For opens $a:U\to V$, $b:V\to X$, $c:X\to Y$, write $E_a=a_{!,\bullet}\dashv F_a$ for the ordinary open adjunctions of [def-sp-varying-ring-operations]. Apply [lem-trf-adjoint-composition-coherence] to $\mathscr S_U,\mathscr S_V,\mathscr S_X,\mathscr S_Y$, with successive left adjoints $E_a,E_b,E_c$ and right adjoints $F_a,F_b,F_c$. Its inverse right-adjoint comparisons $d_{ijk}$ are the inverses of $u_{b,a}:F_aF_b\cong F_{ba}$. The coherence hypothesis is step 2, inverted. For the composite adjunctions [def-weil-pbc-composite-adjunction], [lem-weil-pbc-conjugate-iso-unit-equation] identifies the induced left comparisons with the specified ordinary open compositors $v_{b,a}:E_bE_a\cong E_{ba}$. Consequently
$$v_{c,ba}\circ(E_cv_{b,a})=v_{cb,a}\circ(v_{c,b}E_a).$$
The unit computation of step 3, now with $F=E_a$, $R=F_a$, and the normalized identity comparison of the right adjoint $F_{1}$ from step 3, proves both unit laws for $v$.

source.place: Tag 0B65 (lemma-transformation-between-functors-and-adjoints); same adjoint associativity theorem applied to the open adjunctions

proof.text:
Each $E_a$ is additive and exact, and the derived open adjunction is induced from the ordinary one, as specified by [def-sp-varying-ring-operations]. Apply [lem-weil-pbc-exact-functor-derived-factorization] to $E_a,E_b,E_c$ and their composites. With $b_a:J_aQ\cong QC(E_a)$ and $B_{c,b,a,K}$ the corresponding three-factor realization, the two pastings in the required $e$ equation, after postcomposition with $b_{cba,K}$, are
$$Q(C(v_{c,ba}\circ E_cv_{b,a})_K)B_{c,b,a,K},\qquad Q(C(v_{cb,a}\circ v_{c,b}E_a)_K)B_{c,b,a,K}.$$
Step 6 makes them equal. Apply part (3) of [lem-weil-pbc-localization-universal-property] to conclude equality on the derived categories. Its identity/composition preservation also localizes the two unit equations of step 6. These are the specified derived identity comparisons: the localized unit equation is the unit equation for the induced adjunction, which determines the comparison uniquely. This last uniqueness is [lem-weil-pbc-conjugate-iso-unit-equation], applied to the derived adjunction and the identity adjunction. Thus this proves precisely the normalized $e$ and its units.

source.place: Tag 04VG (lemma-properties-left-localization), natural-transformation enhancement; Tag 0B65 (lemma-transformation-between-functors-and-adjoints), identity normalization

proof.text: Finally let equalities of intermediate or total scheme composites be supplied. Substitute along those equalities in each of the preceding equations. By equality elimination it suffices to treat reflexive equalities, for which every transport is the identity and the result is the equation already proved. Multiple equalities are eliminated successively, so this also covers both parenthesizations with independently named intermediate composites. The argument keeps every adjunction fixed; it neither identifies two different adjunction data nor compares arbitrary choices of units or counits.

split_report.summary: Proved the three normalized coherence families in eight steps. Ordinary section comparisons are checked by the fibre-product universal property, inverse-image and open comparisons use the existing generic adjoint associativity leaf and unit uniqueness, exact localization preserves the equations, and right-derived composition follows by conjugation and mate pasting. Statement unchanged; no new nodes.
split_report.blueprint: fix-prop-coherence proof, sentence on tensor reassociation, evaluation, and adjunction units and counits, and sentence that comparisons preserving units and counits have mates satisfying the same equations; realizes the normalized semilinear compositor ingredient below lem-sf-semilinear-proper-open-mate-pasting.

It is a first split (no re-split note), creates no new nodes, and leaves the item statement byte-identical to the Q49-created version. Step 1: the section-normalized direct-image comparisons are associative and unital because both pastings restrict along maps with the same projections, so fibre-product uniqueness makes them equal. Step 2: I instantiated the Mathlib leaf lem-trf-adjoint-composition-coherence (Adjunction.leftAdjointCompIso_assoc) myself with C0..C3=S_W,S_Z,S_Y,S_X and d=q^{-1}; its hypothesis is the inverse of step 1 and its conclusion is exactly u_{hg,f}(F_f u_{h,g})=u_{h,gf}(u_{g,f}F_h). Step 3: I redid both unit-equation computations by naturality of eta and i; they reduce to q_{1,f}=iT_f and q_{f,1}=T_f i from step 1. Steps 4 and 7: the exact-factorization chase cancels the intermediate factorization maps and localization part (3) promotes the equality, with no boundedness or K-flatness needed. Step 5: c is the conjugate of d^{-1}, the only direction that types; composition reversal plus mate-pasting (2) and (4) give c_{hg,f}(c_{h,g}S_f)=c_{h,gf}(S_h c_{g,f}) and the units. Step 6: same leaf with C0..C3=S_U,S_V,S_X,S_Y and d=u^{-1}; indices checked. Step 8: equality elimination. Sources: Stacks 0D6D (sites-cohomology.tex l.3658) and 0D6E (l.4011) give only existence of the composition isomorphisms, so proof_origin agent is correct; the item serves blueprint main-20261015 fix-prop-coherence composition coherence and unit sk-thm-sf-compatibility clause (1). Every off-unit citation is a Mathlib leaf or a definition, so tool_uses [] is correct, and no SGA source is cited.
